verification_commands.ac1:
root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || root=.
cd "$root" || { echo "FAIL AC-1: cannot cd to the repo root"; exit 1; }
[ -f frontend/src/stores/staffStore.ts ] || { echo "FAIL AC-1: not run from the TableQueue repo root (frontend/src/stores/staffStore.ts missing)"; exit 1; }
grep -q "expiresAt" frontend/src/stores/staffStore.ts || { echo "FAIL AC-1: stores/staffStore.ts does not hold an expiresAt field alongside the token"; exit 1; }
out=$(mktemp)
( cd frontend && npx vitest run src/stores/staffStore.test.ts src/layouts/StaffLayout.test.tsx >"$out" 2>&1 )
rc=$?
if [ $rc -ne 0 ] || grep -Eq "Test Files .*failed" "$out" || ! grep -Eq "Test Files .*passed" "$out"; then
  tail -n 20 "$out"
  echo "FAIL AC-1: expiry lifecycle tests failed (rc=$rc) - last lines above"
  rm -f "$out"
  exit 1
fi
echo "PASS AC-1: $(grep -E 'Test Files' "$out" | head -1 | xargs) - expiresAt stored with the token; hydrated guard + expiry timer treat expiry as logout (destroySession)"
rm -f "$out"
exit 0

verification_commands.ac3:
root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || root=.
cd "$root" || { echo "FAIL AC-3: cannot cd to the repo root"; exit 1; }
[ -f frontend/src/api/client.ts ] || { echo "FAIL AC-3: not run from the TableQueue repo root (frontend/src/api/client.ts missing)"; exit 1; }
grep -q "location\.assign" frontend/src/api/client.ts || { echo "FAIL AC-3: api/client.ts does not redirect via location.assign"; exit 1; }
grep -q "ROUTES" frontend/src/api/client.ts || { echo "FAIL AC-3: api/client.ts does not use the ROUTES constant for the 401 redirect"; exit 1; }

  echo "FAIL AC-3: api/client.ts still assigns window.location.href (must use location.assign(ROUTES.STAFF_LOGIN))"
  exit 1
fi

( cd frontend && npx vitest run src/api/client.test.ts >"$out" 2>&1 )
rc=$?
if [ $rc -ne 0 ] || grep -Eq "Test Files .*failed" "$out" || ! grep -Eq "Test Files .*passed" "$out"; then

  echo "FAIL AC-3: 401 redirect tests failed (rc=$rc) - last lines above"
  rm -f "$out"
  exit 1
fi
echo "PASS AC-3: $(grep -E 'Test Files' "$out" | head -1 | xargs) - 401 redirect via ROUTES.STAFF_LOGIN + location.assign with already-on-login guard"
rm -f "$out"
exit 0
verification_commands.ac4:

n=$(grep -o "setInterval(" frontend/src/hooks/useCountdown.ts | wc -l | tr -d " ")

fi

rm -f "$out"
exit 0

verification_commands.ac7:
root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || root=.
cd "$root" || { echo "FAIL AC-7: cannot cd to the repo root"; exit 1; }
[ -f frontend/package.json ] || { echo "FAIL AC-7: not run from the TableQueue repo root (frontend/package.json missing)"; exit 1; }
out=$(mktemp)
( cd frontend && npx vitest run >"$out" 2>&1 )
rc=$?
if [ $rc -ne 0 ] || grep -Eq "Test Files .*failed" "$out" || ! grep -Eq "Test Files .*passed" "$out"; then
  tail -n 20 "$out"
  echo "FAIL AC-7: full frontend suite failed (rc=$rc) - last lines above"
  rm -f "$out"
  exit 1
fi
tscout=$(mktemp)
( cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit >"$tscout" 2>&1 )
trc=$?
if [ $trc -ne 0 ]; then
  tail -n 20 "$tscout"
  echo "FAIL AC-7: tsc --noEmit failed (rc=$trc) - last lines above"
  rm -f "$out" "$tscout"
  exit 1
fi
bad=$(grep -rnE "\.only\(|\.skip\(|\.todo\(|\bxit\(|\bxdescribe" frontend/src --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -n "$bad" ]; then
  echo "FAIL AC-7: skipped/only test modifiers present in frontend/src:"
  echo "$bad"
  rm -f "$out" "$tscout"
  exit 1
fi
echo "PASS AC-7: $(grep -E 'Test Files' "$out" | head -1 | xargs) + $(grep -E '^\s*Tests' "$out" | head -1 | xargs) - full suite green, tsc --noEmit clean, no skipped/only tests"
rm -f "$out" "$tscout"
exit 0
